title: Add wasm32 target support and zero-retention match_hash (keyed HMAC or omitted unsalted PII hashes)
description: Prepare cmdrvl/boundary-detectors for direct compilation into @cmdrvl/web (https://github.com/cmdrvl/web) and zero-retention Company Brain metadata sidecars. Scope: (1) Guard std::thread::scope in src/lib.rs behind #[cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))] so single-threaded wasm32-unknown-unknown builds never pull thread-spawn paths, and add cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown to CI. (2) Security hardening: Finding.match_hash currently emits an unsalted blake3(match) digest (src/lib.rs hash_match), which is dictionary-recoverable for low-entropy PII like 9-digit SSNs or EINs when findings are serialized to logs or metadata registries. Add a zero-retention redaction mode (defaulting to omitted/ordinal match_hash or opt-in keyed HMAC-SHA256 >= 16-byte key, failing closed on empty/short key; plain unsalted blake3 only under explicit opt-in) plus a structured summary helper emitting only pack/rule counts, severities, and optional one-way ShingleBloom provenance.
acceptance_criteria: cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown passes in CI; default zero-retention scan output contains zero raw values and zero unsalted hashes of low-entropy PII; existing veil/airlock callers remain backward-compatible or cleanly migrated.
